influences.name: Dionne Warwick
influences.context: Growing up in the Bronx, Luther Vandross was mesmerized by the magic of music, particularly by Dionne Warwick's enchanting voice. Hearing her on the radio ignited a passion in him, and seeing her perform live at the Brooklyn Fox Theater left a mark on his heart. He fondly remembers, 'She came on stage and just killed me.' The song Anyone Who Has a Heart inspired him to pursue his own musical dreams.
